hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "${f#$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/}" in api/*) pnpm --dir api exec prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f";; front/*) pnpm --dir front exec prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f";; esac
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "${f#$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/}" in api/*) pnpm --dir api exec eslint "$f" >&2 || exit 2;; front/*) pnpm --dir front exec eslint "$f" >&2 || exit 2;; esac
